name: motion-drag-snap
title: Drag Snap
description: Thẻ được kéo từ ô đầu sang ô đích, hơi nghiêng khi bay, vượt quá vài px rồi bám đúng vào ô và thẳng lại.

moworks.author: moworks

options.from: [x, y, degrees] at the start slot ([−360, 150, −8])
options.over: [x, y, degrees] past the end slot at 68 % ([290, −125, 5])
options.to: [x, y, degrees] in the end slot ([255, −100, 0])
options.backAt: s after the start to return (null)
options.cursor: an optional cursor that carries it

credit.author: Moworks Studio
credit.madeNote: the studio's own motion, written here

moworks.notes: Chip DRAG moves from the start slot (offset −72, +30 px, rotate −8°) to past the end slot (+58, −25 px, rotate 5°) at 68 %, then settles into it (+51, −20 px, rotate 0) by 100 %; 820 ms; the overshoot is keyed, each segment eased in-out (data lists easeOutBack). Dashed start and end slots, arrow between. Params: from / to: ô đầu, ô đích · duration (0.82 s) · overshoot (~7 px, có keyframe) · tilt (−8° → 5° → 0) · ease (power2.inOut).
moworks.titleVi: Kéo thả bám vào ô gần nhất
